items.title: How Cornerstone Transformed Its Global Infrastructure
items.summary: Six data centers. Eleven AWS Regions. 140 million users. Strengthened incident response protocols. Enterprise SaaS providers on aging infrastructure face compounding pressure: escalating costs, mounting technical debt, and a widening gap between customer expectations and what legacy infrastructure can deliver. The question is no longer whether to migrate to the cloud — it is how […]
